title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Vendor Order Terms: Pricing, Promised Ready Date, Confirmation and Shipment
content:
These terms govern how a Ridgeline Special Order Services order is priced and billed and how it moves through the vendor's hands, from placement to the day it is ready.

**1. Price.** An order is placed for one vendor item at its quoted price. It is priced under a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards volume pricing quote, recorded with that quote, only where the program allows ProBuild volume quote pricing, and otherwise at the shelf price.

**2. Promised ready date.** The promised ready date is the order date plus the program's quoted lead time, in calendar days, and it never moves; vendor revisions change only the estimated ready date.

**3. Billing.** The order total is billed on the order date, and the deposit under the Ridgeline Special Order Services deposit terms is taken at the same time.

**4. Vendor confirmation.** The vendor must confirm within the program's vendor confirmation period, in days of the order date, failing which the order is cancelled with the cancellation reason vendor unconfirmed and every payment is refunded.

**5. Template.** Where the program requires a template visit, production may start only after the installer's on-site template is recorded as complete.

**6. Shipment.** A catalog item ships from vendor stock after confirmation, and a made-to-order item ships after production. The vendor may ship part of an order ahead of the rest only where the program allows partial shipment, and the order becomes ready only when every part has been received.

**7. Changes.** An order may be changed without cancelling within the program's change window, in hours after the moment the order was placed, and only while its status is placed; any later change is a cancellation under the Ridgeline Special Order Services cancellation terms followed by a new order.

**8. Remakes.** An item remade because a Ridgeline installer's measurement was wrong is a new order priced as a no-charge remake with an order total of 0.00, where the program carries the Ridgeline measure guarantee; an item made from the customer's own measurements is never remade at no charge.

## Order statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| placed | the order is placed; the vendor has not yet confirmed it |
| vendor confirmed | the vendor has acknowledged the purchase order and confirmed the ship or production date |
| in production | the vendor has started making the made-to-order item |
| shipped | the vendor has shipped a catalog item from its stock, or the finished item |
| ready | the item has been received and checked in at the store and is ready for pickup or delivery |
| completed | the customer has picked the item up or it has been delivered |
| cancelled | cancelled by the customer before production or shipment, or from production under the vendor-delay remedy; or by the system for lack of vendor confirmation or supply, or, from ready, because an item never picked up is treated as abandoned and returned to the vendor |
| returned | the customer has returned a returnable item after completion |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

- A Windows and Exterior Doors order placed on 2 March, with the program's 42-day quoted lead time, has a promised ready date of 13 April. If the vendor later estimates 28 April, the promised ready date stays 13 April and only the estimated ready date becomes 28 April.
- A Semi-Custom Cabinetry order still at status placed 30 hours after it was placed is within the program's 48-hour change window and may be changed without cancelling. If the vendor confirmed it at hour 20, the same change at hour 30 is a cancellation followed by a new order.
- A fabricated countertop whose template is not yet recorded as complete cannot enter production.
